segments.t: When Nagiyev finally wakes up in his office after sleeping off the mushrooms, he finds the restaurant empty except for Vika, who stays behind to talk with him.
Вика, ты хотела со мной поговорить?
Ну и кого я накажу, а?
Вика, ты мне хоть скажи, что происходит здесь?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Lena, forgive me, please.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Lena' and 'please' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Have you seen my little elephant?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'you' before landing on 'little elephant figurine'.
Вика, ты хотела со мной поговорить?
'Vika, did you want to talk with me?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Vika' and finishing on 'to talk'.
'What is this? Some kind of prank, huh?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'what' and finishing on 'and'.
Ну и кого я накажу, а?
'Well, and who am I going to punish, huh?' In spoken Russian, the words stay in their normal statement order and Nagiyev's rising voice at the end turns the line into a question.
Вика, ты мне хоть скажи, что происходит здесь?
'Vika, at least tell me what is going on here?' Dmitry Nagiyev raises the pitch on 'here' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question.
'The only reasonable person!' In Russian, the idea of 'only' flows naturally into 'man' without extra filler words.
'Who never stole.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'stole' to negate the statement.
'Never betrayed me.' Dmitry Nagiyev brings out the contrast between 'never' and 'not' in a few short words.
'Never secretly fried my zucchini.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'fried' to negate the statement.
'So beautiful.' Dmitry Nagiyev brings out the contrast between 'beautiful' and 'so' in a few short words.

'Dmitry Vladimirovich, it is time for you to go home.' Russian expresses feelings and needs by saying 'to me it is needed' or 'to me it seems', putting the person in the 'to me' form. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Вика, ты хотела со мной поговорить?
Ну и кого я накажу, а?
Вика, ты мне хоть скажи, что происходит здесь?
That brings Scene Eighteen to a close. Watch how Nagiyev, touched by Vika's loyalty after his divorce, suddenly sees her in a new light. See you next time!
